passage: Before you send that email, Mahima, sit a minute. Let me tell you something. When I was twenty-five and new at this firm, a supplier and I had a shouting match over a phone call. I was certain he had promised the cloth by the tenth. He was certain he'd said the fifteenth. My boss called me in and asked, "Sharmila, what happened?" passage: Keerthana, you asked on the podcast how I handle fights at work. I'm Pema, and I'll tell you about the one that changed me.
